title: DTEND/DUE Value Type and Floating-ness Match DTSTART

citations.verbatim_quote: The value type of this property MUST be the same as the "DTSTART" property, and its value MUST be later in time than the value of the "DTSTART" property. Furthermore, this property MUST be specified as a date with local time if and only if the "DTSTART" property is also specified as a date with local time.
For cases where this property is specified in a "VTODO" calendar component that also specifies a "DTSTART" property, the value type of this property MUST be the same as the "DTSTART" property
Furthermore, this property MUST be specified as a date with local time if and only if the "DTSTART" property is also specified as a date with local time.

statement: DTEND (VEVENT) and DUE (VTODO) have the same value type (DATE vs DATE-TIME) as DTSTART, and are floating (date with local time) if and only if DTSTART is floating.
rationale: RFC 5545 Sections 3.8.2.2 and 3.8.2.3 state both requirements verbatim. Mixing DATE and DATE-TIME, or floating and zoned values, makes the component's duration undefined.

positive_examples.name: utc_and_tzid
positive_examples.description: UTC DTSTART with TZID DTEND (both zoned).
